notes.title: PolyDestroyer BETA Update
notes.notes:
Dear Pilots,



The latest update has now been pushed to the beta branch! This update includes improved game feel and bug fixes. This is a small bug fix release, the issues from the last beta build are still being worked on and have not been fixed for this release.

Here is a video which shows how to switch to the beta branch: Watch here.
New Features & Improvements
Improved game feel: We have added screen shake feedback for when you hit enemies or take damage. This is different for each weapon, for example it is more intense on the exploding weapon.


Bug Fixes
Decreased the volume of the intro splash screen, it was very loud before.

Fixed a crash when reaching higher waves, this was an issue with previous fixes to how the game manages the pool of objects being spawned in.


Known issues with this beta build
Here is a list of known issues, these will be fixed for the next beta release.

When turbo or shield inventory is full the game still destroys pickup objects when flown into.

Sound effects stack on top of each other and gets very loud. (This was helped in this update by removing the enemy fire sound effect for now.)

Controller glyphs for the turbo and shield do not appear. (North and West buttons activate those)

Enemy remaining counter is inaccurate, it seems to be losing track of how many enemies are spawned so there are leftover enemies at the end of waves.

Collected powerups are kept after dying.

Highest wave achieved text doesn't reset when resetting the game save.

Equipped skin stays the same when resetting the game save.

Game over sound is played when SFX is muted.

Options screen does not get translated when choosing a different language.


What's next?
For the next beta update we will be fixing the list of issues above along with anything that the community reports to us.

When this is finished and tested, the next production build will be released!

In the future we plan to add more ship customization, new ship weaponry, online multiplayer modes, and leaderboards.


Send us your feedback for this build
If you encounter bugs while playing the game, or want to suggest improvements and new features, we want to hear about them!

You can give us your feedback on this build by sending an email to hello@crunchycodegames.com, or by creating a post in our Discord servers feedback forum.


Join the Community
PolyDestroyer is an early-access title, and your feedback is invaluable in shaping its future. As well as Discord, you can join our Steam community to stay updated on the latest developments and share your thoughts!

Thank you all for your support!

The PolyDestroyer Team.

notes.title: PolyDestroyer BETA Update
notes.notes:
Dear pilots,

We are excited to announce the first beta update for PolyDestroyer! This update introduces improved user interface and gameplay flow improvements!
Here is a video which shows how to switch to the beta branch: Watch here.

New Features & Improvements
Improved UI: We've given the main menu, loadout page, and options menus user interface a complete overhaul to improve the navigation of the menus when using a controller, and to make the flow of getting into the gameplay quicker and easier. The video, audio and language options interface has been moved to the main menu.
New way to unlock weapons: While playing the game keep a look out for the new ship pickup item, with a new blue indicator to help you find it. On collection you have a chance to unlock a random new weapon!
Sound effects: More sound effects have been added into the game for item pickups (Coins, Health, Turbo, Shield, and Weapon Pickups) and enemy attacks.
Engine upgrade: PolyDestroyer now uses Unity 6.1.

Bug Fixes

 Coins are now spawned around the players location correctly.
 Health pickups now spawn correctly when the next wave begins.
 An issue where the player death sound doesn't play on player death has now been fixed.
 An issue where audio would not play at all in some situations has now been fixed.
 Objects are now correctly tracked and destroyed by the game on player death or exit to main menu.
 Some sound effects volume was not changed when using the SFX slider, this is now fixed.
 Loadout page now refreshes it's buttons correctly, showing current status of locked/equipped/unequipped items.
 Cosmetic price text is now hidden once the cosmetic has been purchased, to avoid confusion.

notes.title: Shield Mechanic + Achievements Update is out now!
notes.notes:
Dear pilots,

We are excited to announce an update to PolyDestroyer! This update introduces the shield mechanic and two new achievements! Here's what's new:

New Features & Improvements
Shield Mechanic Added: Collect the new Shield Pick-Ups just like you do with health packs. Your ship can hold up to three shields at a time, displayed on the HUD. To activate a shield, press E on the keyboard, Y on the Xbox Controller, or Triangle on the PlayStation controller. When activated, your ship will pulse blue, indicating the shield is active for five seconds. During this time, your ship is completely immune to damage.
New Achievements: We've added two new achievements! The first is granted when you open the game, and the second is a secret. (Hint: the build number might give you a clue!) More achievements will be added soon!
Improved UI: We've revamped the Title Screen and Pause Menu to make them less cluttered and easier to navigate.
Improved HUD: The HUD layout has been updated for better readability while playing.

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where the ship would slow down after pausing and unpausing the game.
Fixed an issue where enemies would continue to spawn in the background if you returned to the title screen under certain conditions.

What's Next?
Stay tuned for our next update which will add the turbo mechanic and an improved way of unlocking weapons. We apologize for the delay; the weapon system needs a bit more polishing.
In the future we plan to add more ship customization, new ship weaponry, online multiplayer modes, and leaderboards.

PolyDestroyer is an early-access title, and your feedback is invaluable in shaping its future. As well as Discord, you can join our Steam community to stay updated on the latest developments and share your thoughts!

Thank you all for your support!

The PolyDestroyer Team.

notes.title: Localisation Update is out now!
notes.notes:
Dear pilots,

We are excited to announce an update to PolyDestroyer! This update introduces 7 new languages and improved graphics settings! Here's what's new:

New Features & Improvements

 Localisation For 7 Languages Added: French, German, Spanish, Japanese, Norwegian, Irish, and Welsh. Select a language using the new Language button on the title screen.
 Improved Graphics Settings: Added more supported resolutions, Added a toggle for V-Sync, Added dropdown for Fullscreen, Windowed, and Fullscreen Windowed.
 New game background: Changed star particle background to give the player a reference point, it was sometimes difficult to tell if the ship was moving.
 Shop Changes: You can no longer access the shop while in-game. You must select your weapons and skin on the title screen before entering the game.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed an issue where the "Highest Wave Achieved" counter on the title screen displayed an incorrect value.
 Fixed an issue where resetting your save file did not reset the "Highest Wave Achieved" value properly.
 Fixed an issue where returning to the title screen does not reshow the Options and Store buttons in some cases.


What's Next?
Stay tuned for our next update which will add Steam achievements and an improved way of unlocking weapons.
In the future we plan to add more ship customization, new ship weaponry, online multiplayer modes, and leaderboards.
